position_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily metrics; sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio
depth_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily bookDepth; cumulative notional at -1% bid and +1% ask
hourly_sampling: last valid observation in each UTC hour for each source
direction: score up-cross zero -> SHORT; score down-cross zero -> LONG
oos_read_policy: 2024 unread unless 2023 passes; 2025+ unread unless both 2023 and 2024 pass
